evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/g/a owns exactly four public int fields representing two coordinate pairs and exposes setLow(int,int) plus setHigh(int,int) style mutators.
The four-int constructor calls the two pair mutators; the two-int constructor delegates to (0,0,width,height), exactly matching the established RuneScape Bounds implementation.
Public RuneScape/RSPS Bounds source matches the v308 class including the same four-field order, constructor delegation, mutator behavior and even toString() returning null.

proposals.note: Original RuneScape Bounds identity recovered from exact structural/source fingerprint.
